baseline.summary: The original interface was technically competent but read as a status-heavy dashboard. It exposed evidence and chain proof, but the product story, decision hierarchy, Evidence Gate concept, strategy comparison, and DreamDEX lifecycle narrative were not strong enough for a first-time judge.

problemsIdentified: Product purpose was not visually dominant within the first screen.
Infrastructure metadata competed with the verdict and evidence story.
The verdict did not feel like the result of evidence dimensions passing through a deterministic gate.
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE read like a raw machine state instead of a deliberate protection against overconfidence.
Forecast evidence, tradeability, settlement evidence, and realized PnL were present but not visually separated enough.
Reference A and Reference B comparison did not answer which strategy had stronger evidence and why.
DreamDEX proof was hash-heavy and did not clearly narrate approval, submitted order, no fill, post-expiry terminal event, and escrow reconciliation.
The true terminal event, OrderExpired, needed stronger emphasis so the interface did not imply a successful cancellation.
Mobile responsiveness worked mechanically but weakened the core decision story.
Technical proof links needed to remain available without dominating the main product narrative.

designDirection.visualConcept: A calm strategy-validation instrument built around evidence gates, not a trading exchange or generic crypto dashboard.
designDirection.signatureElement: Evidence Gate: candidate strategy input, distinct evidence dimensions, and an output verdict that blocks promotion when required evidence is missing.
designDirection.navigationModel: Single-page workflow with anchored sections: Overview, Strategies, Evidence, DreamDEX proof, and Details.
designDirection.responsiveStrategy: Desktop keeps the decision and Evidence Gate in the initial story. Mobile preserves the same order while converting the comparison matrix and lifecycle proof into stacked, labeled proof units.

implementedChanges: Rebuilt the first viewport around the statement: Test a strategy before exposing it to testnet capital.
Added a dominant INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE verdict panel with sample count, additional requirement, and open-order status.
Created the Evidence Gate visual structure with Forecast sample, Forecast calibration, DreamDEX tradeability, Risk envelope, Settlement evidence, and Realized PnL as separate dimensions.
Reworked strategy comparison so Reference A and Reference B are compared across observations, calibration, tradeability, risk, PnL, and promotion status without synthetic metrics.
Reframed DreamDEX proof as a lifecycle: VERIFIED approval, SUBMITTED post-only order, NO FILL, EXPIRED terminal event, and RECONCILED escrow/open-order state.
Moved transaction hashes, order ID, chain ID, SDK version, and API source into a secondary technical proof section with explorer links.
Updated E2E coverage for first impression, evidence separation, truthful OrderExpired reporting, strategy comparison, proof links, keyboard navigation, console errors, and horizontal overflow.
Updated the demo script to narrate the Evidence Gate and insufficiency-as-protection concept.

productLogicPreserved.evidenceRules: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE remains a first-class outcome when the forecast sample is incomplete or evidence classes are unavailable.
productLogicPreserved.dreamdexLifecycle: The UI reports the real terminal state as OrderExpired after the owner-approved cancel transaction landed after expiry. It does not label the lifecycle as cancelled.
productLogicPreserved.humanAuthorization: The UI presents proof of the prior human-approved lifecycle and does not introduce any autonomous write path.
productLogicPreserved.noFabricatedData: No historical books, fills, liquidity, settlements, PnL, confidence, or calibration metrics were invented.
productLogicPreserved.verdictLogic: Promotion remains blocked because the sample requirement and required evidence classes are not satisfied.

desktop.notes: Decision, value proposition, and Evidence Gate are visible early. Comparison and lifecycle proof remain readable.

mobile.notes: No horizontal overflow. Evidence Gate, verdict, comparison labels, and lifecycle semantics remain legible.

accessibility.notes: Semantic sections, accessible labels, keyboard navigation, visible focus states, and non-color status labels were preserved or strengthened.

demoFlow.notes: The narrator can move from decision to Evidence Gate, strategy comparison, DreamDEX proof, and technical evidence without relying on fabricated performance claims.
